Featured projects

Four projects, each starting from a business question.

Adidas US Sales Analytics

Retail | Sales Analytics | Profitability | Business Intelligence

A six-page interactive sales performance dashboard covering revenue, operating profit, products, retailers, regions, sales channels and monthly trends for 2020 to 2021.

Key business problem: Where do revenue and profit come from, and which products, retailers, regions and sales channels need attention on profitability?

$899.9MRevenue
$332MOperating profit
36.91%Operating margin
2.5MUnits sold
$363Avg price per unit
71.74%Revenue from top 3 retailers
What it analyses

Revenue and operating profit by product, retailer, region, state and sales method, plus pricing and monthly trends. Findings include Men’s Street Footwear as the top product, three retailers driving most revenue, and in-store sales leading revenue with the lowest margin.

FMCG Production & Inventory Root Cause Analysis

FMCG | Inventory Analytics | Root Cause Analysis | Business Intelligence

A business investigation rather than just a dashboard, tracing where production, sales, demand and inventory fall out of step.

Key business problem: Are we producing the right products, in the right quantities, at the right time, and in the right locations to meet actual customer demand?

13%Sell-through rate
1.63Production-to-sales ratio
9MDemand-supply gap
2.95Inventory turnover
123.93Days of inventory on hand
82.01MTotal inventory units
What it investigates

Production, sales, demand, inventory, SKU performance, regional allocation, demand forecasting, production planning, slow-moving products and inventory policies. It goes beyond reporting numbers to the underlying business problem.

Zentrova — Business Performance Dashboard

SaaS | Revenue & Retention | Growth | Reliability & Cost | Business Intelligence

A four-page business performance dashboard connecting revenue, retention, growth, product usage, support, reliability and cloud cost in one view.

Key business problem: Is revenue growth sustainable once retention, failed payments, onboarding, support load, reliability and cloud cost are taken into account?

$1.92MRevenue
$900KMarketing spend
53.64%Paid churn
88.31%Payment success
$669KCloud cost
$352KContribution margin
What it analyses

Revenue and subscriptions, churn, payments and refunds, marketing spend and acquisition channels, onboarding and conversion, feature usage, support tickets and satisfaction, incidents and cloud cost. Built on nine related tables covering 5,127 users and 14,794 payments from January 2025 to September 2026.
